title: Squeezing-Fueled Quantum Otto Engine via Measurement-Induced Cooling: The Two-Qubit Quantum Rabi Model
summary: We investigate a quantum Otto engine (QOE) constructed from the two-qubit quantum Rabi model, operating within a cavity quantum electrodynamics (QED) architecture. The engine operates with two qubits as the working substance and a single non-Markovian hot thermal bath, modeled via the hierarchical equations of motion (HEOM) formalism. In place of a conventional cold thermal reservoir, the cooling stroke is realized through a projective measurement protocol on the cavity mode, which acts as an ancillary subsystem and effectively mimics a cold bath for the qubit working medium via measurement…
